Title: Add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and open the cart and check the backpack is listed once
Steps: 1. Add "Sauce Labs Backpack". 2. Open the cart.
Expected Result: The cart page lists the backpack once.

Title: Add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Bike Light" and check both are listed in the cart
Steps: 1. Add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Bike Light". 2. Open the cart.

Title: Remove "Sauce Labs Backpack" inside the cart and check the cart is empty
Steps: 1. Add "Sauce Labs Backpack". 2. Open the cart. 3. Click "Remove".
Expected Result: The cart is empty and the cart badge disappears.

Title: Click "Continue Shopping" in the cart and check the products page opens
Click "Checkout" in the cart and check the "Your Information" step opens
Steps: 1. Add "Sauce Labs Backpack". 2. Open the cart. 3. Click "Checkout".
